scripts.deploy:production: npm run deploy && npm run deploy:verify
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build:web && cap sync ios
scripts.cap:ios:storekit: VK_ENVIRONMENT=production VK_SUBSCRIPTION_MODE=apple_native npm run build:web && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:sync: VK_ENVIRONMENT=production VK_SUBSCRIPTION_MODE=apple_native npm run build:web && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:build:simulator: npm run check:ios-toolchain && npm run ios:sync && node scripts/ios-build.mjs simulator
scripts.ios:build:release-check: npm run check:ios-toolchain && npm run ios:sync && node scripts/ios-build.mjs release
scripts.cap:android: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.cap:android:billing: VK_ENVIRONMENT=production VK_SUBSCRIPTION_MODE=google_native npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.native:ios: npm run cap:ios && npm run cap:open:ios
scripts.native:android: npm run cap:android && npm run cap:open:android
scripts.build:android:debug: npm run cap:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:bundle: npm run cap:android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
